description: Host-matrix adapters for Claude Code and Codex, each run once for real on macOS and recorded
acceptance_criteria: The self-test reads a turn that exits 75 as UNAVAILABLE naming the reason, on macOS and Linux
Claude Code and Codex each have an adapter under integrations/<host>/adapter.sh
One real macOS run of each host is recorded as a manual case with its verdict and receipt, whatever the verdict

answers.constraints: The cli lessons in specs/cli/cli.3md (local Git identity in disposable repositories; plain-text gates in tasks; the delta frozen at approval; confirm an external agent can start before relying on it) and PR #254's review: the harness stays POSIX sh and runs under dash.
